breakdown.title: The Sofa Roller Coaster
breakdown.logline: At a movie theater with sofa seating, the dreamer watches a huge neighboring sofa turn into an ordinary amusement park roller coaster, amazed but uneasy.
breakdown.world_logic: A movie theater has blue sofa seats and one side is free, a sofa turns into a roller coaster and the dreamer accepts it.

moments.action: The dreamer and their girlfriend sit on a blue sofa in a movie theater filled with people sitting on blue sofa seats instead of normal seats. A large sofa stands next to them, taller than theirs.

moments.action: The large sofa next to the dreamer turns into a roller coaster, like a real one from an amusement park. The dreamer looks amazed at it.

plan.view: The camera is the dreamer's eyes, on the blue sofa, at the height of their eyes sitting, leaning forward a little, turned to their left, toward the roller coaster (what the big sofa turned into): it looks toward the left side of the room. A wide lens, about 24mm. Nearest, close, in the left third of the picture: the girlfriend, sitting beside the dreamer on the same blue sofa, in profile, looking toward the right of the picture, seen from the waist up and filling the picture from a third of the way down to its bottom edge. Then, a little way off, across the picture from the left third to the right third: the roller coaster (what the big sofa turned into), right beside the blue sofa, filling the picture from its middle to its bottom edge, partly hidden behind the girlfriend. Farthest, far off, at the left edge of the picture: the crowd, many of them, sitting in rows of seats behind the dreamer's row, turned three-quarters toward the camera, looking toward the right of the picture, partly hidden behind the girlfriend. At the right edge of the picture: the screen, the front of the place.
